uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2085-5921-5970-8296.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2063-4551-8089.description:
Activate Mischievous Poltergeist by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1981-2415-5686-7173.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5686-7173.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2842-4681-5170-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

225-1308-4365-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2665-2743-7824.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1263-4871-5147-6026.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

338-1496-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1496-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1909-4486-7488.description:
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Topiary Lecturer.
Repeat.
1909-4486-7488.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

1170-1177-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten and Longshot trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Narset.
Resolve the Longshot trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

851-1322-1563-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

338-2557-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-2557-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5330-6972-7155.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4050-5434-5555-7046.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
4050-5434-5555-7046.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3490-5789-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-5789-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-3769-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2511-3769-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1976-3532-5078-6768.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
1976-3532-5078-6768.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3781-4191-5686--122.description:
Cast the Insect from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast the Insect from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Resolve the Zask ability, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-2445-4474-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2060-4929-5652-6260.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Caradora.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

4067-5611-6254.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control at least one Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
4067-5611-6254.description:
Activate a Sliver by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the Sliver.
Repeat.

366-1089-1339.notablePrerequisites:
Curiosity attached to Purphoros.
You have a way to draw a card.
366-1089-1339.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Purphoros, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1887-3933-4929-5479.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1887-3933-4929-5479.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

277-1737-1912-2544-4754.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Razortide Bridge.
When Razortide Bridge enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping it.
Activate the Razortide Bridge token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1283-1409-2034-3895.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Diregraf Horde.
1283-1409-2034-3895.description:
Activate Diregraf Horde by paying {2}, blinking it.
When Diregraf Horde enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Diregraf Horde.
Resolve the Diregraf Horde trigger, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

539-4878-5137.notablePrerequisites:
Market Festival attached to Morphling.
Morphling does not have summoning sickness.
539-4878-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {G}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {U} and one mana of any color.
Activate Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat

193-787-3908-4235.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to four permanents that can tap to produce at least {2}.
Aminatou has at least two loyalty counters.
193-787-3908-4235.description:
Activate up to four permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, targeting Teferi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Aminatou's ability, targeting Spark Double.
Resolve both Aminatou abilities, blinking Teferi and Spark Double, choosing to have Spark Double enter the battlefield as a copy of Aminatou.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, targeting up to four permanents.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Resolve the Teferi ability, untapping up to four permanents you control.
Activate up to four permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, targeting Teferi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Spark Double's ability, targeting Aminatou.
Resolve both Spark Double abilities, blinking Teferi and Aminatou.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, targeting up to four permanents.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Resolve the Teferi ability, untapping up to four permanents you control.
Repeat.
If the four permanents can produce at least {3}, you may instead use Teferi's first loyalty ability once you have infinite mana to put your library into your hand, or you may instead blink any other desired permanent.

1925-1981-4378.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You have a way to cause the additional creature to die.
Curse of Death's Hold attached to you.
1925-1981-4378.description:
Cause the additional creature to die.
Sanguinary Priest triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain one life.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield as a 0/0 due to Curse of Death's Hold and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

1778-2232-3338-4702.notablePrerequisites: Splinter Twin attached to Mirran Spy.
1778-2232-3338-4702.description:
Activate Mirran Spy by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
The token Mirran Spy enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Each Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki and any other creature(s) you control.
Repeat.

1349-4050-4153.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has a coin counter on it.
1349-4050-4153.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Athreos trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter on another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature that died in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1696-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
1696-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it.
When Coretapper dies, Shirei triggers, creating a delayed triggered ability.
Resolve Coretapper's ability, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Shirei's delayed ability from step 3 triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

527-539-4657.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
527-539-4657.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Selvala.
Repeat.

654-880-2783.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-2783.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control.
If the creature was a Dragon Egg, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
